body: The Rumson serves Ghanaian comfort food in Labone, Accra, every day from 11am to 11pm: goat pepper soup, kelewele with groundnuts, oxtail sauce, jollof.
It opened in 2024 for dine-in, takeaway and delivery.
The menu works like a shop: search, a price filter, sorting and ten categories from small plates to drinks.
Every dish has its own page with dietary tags and a picture. The cart shows tax and takes a promo code, and checkout runs in three steps (details, delivery, payment) with payment through Reevit.

list: Party size, a date, lunch or dinner seatings every half hour, the occasion and any special requests.
Sign-up and sign-in for membership and faster checkout.
Heritage, events, a journal and contact with WhatsApp.
